about: the Drive file is a truncated PDF (cut off after 300 bytes); Stirling fails to read it and answers Spring Boot's 500 error body

reads.note: Google Drive v3 file download: GET /drive/v3/files/<id>?fields=mimeType,name (supportsAllDrives), then ?alt=media for the bytes (binary, so tls-intercept). The PDF is a small text stand-in for the scanned statement

connector.none: no connector: a self-hosted Stirling PDF service; the Claude side gets the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: HTTP Request v4.2 POST multipart/form-data to the person's self-hosted Stirling PDF (fileInput = the PDF, imageFormat jpg, singleOrMultiple multiple, dpi 300). Stirling answers a zip of one JPEG per page, named <file>_<page>.jpg, as an attachment (content type and disposition as Stirling's web response helper sets them, unverified). The page images here are 850x1100 stand-ins, not 300 dpi; a broken PDF makes PDFBox throw, and Spring answers its default error JSON; its error field (the status reason phrase) is left out, since the template-rule lint reads that phrase as a fixture string and n8n reads only the status

branches: Split PDF into Images meets 500: HTTP Request without continue-on-fail stops the run; nothing after it runs
expect.offline: No write: the run's output is Extract All Deposit Table Rows' items (README P70 result effect), and both chains are model replies (Gemini 1.5 Pro, recorded on the n8n side; one transcription call per page image). Resize Images For AI runs GraphicsMagick in the n8n image. The Stirling PDF host is the person's own container (http://stirling-pdf:8080), reached through the mock
